No Experience Needed! | Commission-Based + Big Bonuses | Paid Weekly!

Port Moresby/Ela Beach Hotel-Pacific Privilege office

Paid Weekly

Commission-Based

Big Bonuses & Incentives

Career Growth

Be confident, well-spoken, and presentable
Fluent English (Tok Pisin is a plus!)
Based in Port Moresby and ready to start right away
No experience required
– just bring the right attitude!

not required
